name: Megadramon
main_effect:
When this card would be played, by trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Ver.4] trait card from your hand, reduce the play cost by 2.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete 2 of your opponent's play cost 4 or lower Digimon. For each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards, add 1 to this effect's play cost maximum.
source_effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By unsuspending this Digimon, delete 1 of your Digimon with the lowest level.
